fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 5 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the maximum range of 5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fell the Quarry
fusions.desc: Finishes an enemy at or below 30% health for 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Closing Sprint
fusions.desc: A burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fixed on the Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
